name: ceramics-api
description: The single backend service for the store: owns the product catalog, inventory, shopping cart, checkout/payment orchestration (via Stripe), order history, and the admin operations for catalog, inventory, and order-fulfillment management. Exposed only to the two webapps behind the gateway (intranet exposure) — it is not reachable directly from the public internet, and it issues no tokens of its own (Thunder is the IDP).

dependencies.name: ceramics-db
dependencies.description: Stores products, inventory levels, carts, orders, and order status history.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Validates the bearer token the gateway forwards and resolves the caller's Shopper/Admin role.

dependencies.name: stripe
dependencies.description: Charges the shopper's payment method via Stripe's Payment Intents API during checkout.

config.description: Stripe secret API key used to create and confirm payment intents.

dependencies.name: email-provider
dependencies.description: Sends the order-confirmation email via SendGrid once checkout succeeds.

config.description: SendGrid API key used to send transactional emails.
Verified sender address order-confirmation emails are sent from.
